steps.title: 声明完成 · 交给采纳门
steps.detail: 模型说大殿已完成，由采纳门决定能否交付。
steps.evidence: The East Main Hall of Foguang Temple has been designed and built to the brief. It is a single-storey timber hall on a stone platform, 7 bays across the front and 4 bays deep, with outer columns 34 m apart and 17.7 m deep, two rings of columns, large bracket sets on every column head about 61% of the column height, deep eaves, and a single hipped roof with gentle slopes. Structural checks passed: inventory shows no floating parts, bearing shows 0 hanging, load-path weights show all columns within compression limits, settle shows 0 fell or shifted, shake shows 0 pieces came down and minimal drift. The brief check confirms the hall answers the brief, and shot-judge on brief.png passed.

short_of_the_brief: 240 timber pieces stand past the edge of the roof, with no covering over them: 96 bracket arms, 96 bracket blocks, 48 outriggers; along the hall they reach 20.8 m from the middle and the covering ends at 18.5, and across it they reach 12.65 m from the middle and the covering ends at 10.35: the eave ring must stand further out than the bracket sets reach, or the eave-out be longer
